notes: Live confirmation layer: one ScenarioSuite.exe window per task, launched
by the runner (except launch-type tasks, where the agent starts a second
scenario itself). Assertions are evaluated by an INDEPENDENT session that
observes after the loop finishes - never on the agent's refs, never on
mock state. {app} in an instruction is substituted with the exe path.
Assertion kinds: the mock kinds, plus children_count_min and
window_title_contains (checked against the assertion session's windows).

tasks.instruction: 在商品列表里找到 "Special Item 17"，把它加入购物车。
在表单里把姓名填为 测试员，勾选"同意条款"，然后点提交。
通过菜单栏的"文件"菜单执行"新建"。
删除列表的最后一项，在出现的确认框里点"确定"。
用 launch 工具启动一个新程序：命令是 "{app}"，参数是 ["form"]。等它的窗口出现后，告诉我启动是否成功。
